title: Verifiable Visual Rewards Transfer from Synthetic Scenes to Natural Prompts

paragraphs.en: Precise instruction following in image generation, such as satisfying object counts and spatial relations, remains an open challenge at least in part because it is learned using unreliable reward models such as object detectors and vision-language models. We introduce Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR), the first framework for programmatically verifiable image rewards, and show that training on it generalizes to natural prompts. Each VVR task is a scene of geometric objects and relations among them, from which we derive both the prompt and a deterministic verifier, so tasks can be generated in any number and at any chosen complexity. We release VVRBench , with 10,000 tasks over 32 constraint types, and VVRBench -Challenge, with 720 more complex tasks; the strongest model we evaluate—GPT-Image-2.5—solves 21.4% of VVRBench -Challenge. Using VVR scores as rewards for reinforcement learning (RLVVR) raises the accuracy of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium on VVRBench from 2.8% to 28.3% and demonstrates consistent easy-to-hard generalization. These gains extend to out-of-domain benchmarks, and mixing VVR into existing objectives further improves overall performance and human preference, motivating the adoption of VVR into standard image generation post-training recipes.

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has improved how precisely language models follow instructions: constraints such as use the word X at least three times are checked by code and used directly as rewards ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Lambert et al., 2025 ; Pyatkin et al., 2025 ) , but image generation has no equivalent reward. Text-to-image generators often fail to follow instructions precisely: given three red circles to the left of two blue squares , they draw the wrong counts, colors, or positions, and fail more often as a prompt combines more requirements ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023 ; Kamath et al., 2025 ) . Post-training rewards for instruction following come from learned evaluators: preference models ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ) , vision-language models (VLMs) that answer questions about the image ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Cho et al., 2024a ; Lin et al., 2024 ) , and object detectors ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) . These evaluators make errors on the judgments that instruction following depends on ( Saxon et al., 2024 ; Wiles et al., 2025 ; Kajić et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Kamath et al., 2025 ) , and policies trained on them exploit these errors ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 采用可验证奖励的强化学习已经提升了语言模型执行指令的精确度：例如“至少使用三次单词 X”这类约束条件可以通过代码进行验证，并直接作为奖励使用（Zhou 等，2023；Lambert 等，2025；Pyatkin 等，2025），但图像生成领域尚无类似的奖励机制。 文本到图像生成器通常无法精确执行指令：当提示要求“在两个蓝色方块的左侧绘制三个红色圆圈”时，它们常常会错误地绘制数量、颜色或位置，并且随着提示中要求的增加，出错频率也会更高（Ghosh 等，2023；Huang 等，2023；Kamath 等，2025）。 用于指令执行的训练后奖励来自学习到的评估器：包括偏好模型（Kirstain 等，2023；Xu 等，2023）、能够回答图像相关问题的视觉语言模型（VLMs）（Hu 等，2023；Cho 等，2024a；Lin 等，2024），以及物体检测器（Ghosh 等，2023）。 这些评估器在指令执行所依赖的判断上存在错误（Saxon 等，2024；Wiles 等，2025；Kajić 等，2024；Chen 等，2025b；Kamath 等，2025），而基于这些评估器训练的策略则会利用这些错误（Zhang 等，2024；Kim 等，2024；Hong 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR), the first framework for programmatically verifiable image rewards, in which the generated image is scored deterministically by verifiers : Python functions over pixels, with no learned detector, OCR system, embedding model, or VLM. VVR covers instructions with clear, objective requirements combining color, count, shape, and spatial relations (Figure 1 ). Unlike constraints in text instruction following, which govern mostly separate properties of the output (e.g., length, keyword, format) and can be excluded pair by pair ( Pyatkin et al., 2025 ) , visual constraints lead to more complicated compatibility conflicts. For example, in “ A contains B, B contains C, and C contains A ,” every pair of constraints can be satisfiable, but the three together are not. Therefore, we propose a generator that guarantees constraint satisfiability under compositions, and compose natural-language instructions from the valid constraint sets. With our generator and constraint taxonomy, new VVR tasks can be generated in any number and at any chosen complexity, for evaluation or for training. Program verifiers of each VVR constraint also enable fine-grained diagnosis of generator capability over different types of instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了可验证视觉奖励（Verifiable Visual Rewards，VVR），这是首个支持程序化验证图像奖励的框架。在该框架中，生成的图像由验证器以确定性方式评分：这些验证器是作用于像素的 Python 函数，无需任何学习型检测器、OCR 系统、嵌入模型或视觉语言模型（VLM）。 VVR 涵盖具有明确、客观要求的指令，这些要求结合了颜色、数量、形状和空间关系（图 1）。 与文本指令遵循中的约束不同——后者主要控制输出的独立属性（例如长度、关键词、格式），并且可以成对排除（Pyatkin et al., 2025）——视觉约束会导致更复杂的兼容性冲突。 例如，在“A 包含 B，B 包含 C，且 C 包含 A”这一指令中，任意两个约束之间可能都可满足，但三者同时满足则不可能。 因此，我们提出了一种生成器，能够确保约束在组合条件下仍然可满足，并基于有效的约束集来构建自然语言指令。 借助我们的生成器和约束分类体系，可以生成任意数量、任意复杂度的新 VVR 任务，用于评估或训练。 每个 VVR 约束的程序化验证器还能对生成器在处理不同指令类型时的能力进行精细诊断。

paragraphs.en: VVRBench . We instantiate VVR with colored geometric shapes and 46 constraint types over counts, attributes, and spatial relations and release VVRBench , with 10,000 tasks across five complexity ranges, and VVRBench -Challenge , with 720 more complex tasks to discriminate among frontier models (§ 3 ). The strongest open-weight model, FLUX.2-dev, achieves 19.2% accuracy on VVRBench , and the strongest model overall, GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst, solves 21.4% of VVRBench -Challenge. Failures concentrate in the (e.g., “twice as many A as B” ) and (e.g., “each A is inside a different B” ) constraint families. The benchmark can be updated with higher complexity as frontier models evolve.

paragraphs.en: RLVVR. We use the verifiable VVR scores as rewards for reinforcement learning (RLVVR) to train image generators to follow instructions precisely. To study how training complexity affects generalization, we procedurally generate two training corpora: VVR-Easy contains only low complexity tasks of at most one constraint family, and VVR-Matched matches the VVRBench distribution. We show that 1) training on easy distribution generalizes to harder tasks, 2) training on harder tasks teaches compositionality, 3) training on colored shapes transfer to out-of-domain natural prompts to improve position and counting, and, most importantly, 4) mixing VVR with existing post-training objectives (e.g., GenEval2, OCR, PickScore) improves general benchmark performance and human preference, motivating the adoption of VVR into standard image generation post-training recipes. Our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: RLVVR。 我们将可验证的 VVR 分数用作强化学习（RLVVR）的奖励，以训练图像生成器精确遵循指令。 为了研究训练复杂度如何影响泛化能力，我们通过程序生成两个训练语料库：VVR-Easy 仅包含最多一个约束族、复杂度较低的任务；而 VVR-Matched 则与 VVRBench 的分布相匹配。 我们发现：1）在简单分布上进行训练能够泛化到更复杂的任务；2）在更复杂的任务上进行训练能够教会模型组合性；3）对彩色形状的训练可以迁移到域外自然提示，从而提升位置识别和计数能力；最重要的是，4）将 VVR 与现有的后训练目标（例如 GenEval2、OCR、PickScore）相结合，能够提升通用基准测试表现和人类偏好度，这为将 VVR 纳入标准的图像生成后训练流程提供了动力。我们的贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: Each constraint in 𝒜 \mathcal{A} is instantiated with a constraint type from the constraint library and one or more object groups. Every group has exactly one color constraint and one shape constraint; all other constraints are optional. Appendix A.2 shows a complete task.

paragraphs.en: A valid task must satisfy three desiderata: 1) Well-formed: every constraint uses a defined type with supported parameter values, such as one of eight colors or three shapes, and refers to as many object groups in 𝒢 \mathcal{G} as its type requires; 2) Jointly satisfiable: at least one placement and sizing of the specified objects satisfies all constraints in ℬ \mathcal{B} , 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , and ℱ \mathcal{F} simultaneously; and 3) Faithfully expressed: p p states every constraint in ℬ \mathcal{B} , 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , and ℱ \mathcal{F} without any addition or omission.
paragraphs.zh: 一个有效的任务必须满足三个要求：1）结构正确：每个约束都使用已定义的类型及其支持的参数值，例如八种颜色之一或三种形状，并且引用的 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 中的对象组数量与其类型所要求的一致；2）联合可满足性：至少存在一种指定对象的放置和尺寸配置，能够同时满足 ℬ \mathcal{B}、𝒜 \mathcal{A} 和 ℱ \mathcal{F} 中的所有约束；以及 3）忠实表达：p p 完整表达了 ℬ \mathcal{B}、𝒜 \mathcal{A} 和 ℱ \mathcal{F} 中的每一个约束，既没有添加也没有遗漏任何内容。

paragraphs.en: VVR is an open-ended image generation task, where any image that satisfies all constraints receives full credit, so the verifier has to be reference-free. It takes in the generated RGB image x x and the formal constraints ( 𝒢 , ℬ , 𝒜 , ℱ ) (\mathcal{G},\mathcal{B},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{F}) of the task and produces a correctness decision.
paragraphs.zh: VVR 是一项开放式的图像生成任务，任何满足所有约束条件的图像都能获得满分，因此验证器必须不依赖参考图像。 该任务接收生成的 RGB 图像 x 和任务的正式约束条件（𝒢, ℬ, 𝒜, ℱ）(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{B},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{F})，并输出一个正确性判断。

sents.en: It takes in the generated RGB image x x and the formal constraints ( 𝒢 , ℬ , 𝒜 , ℱ ) (\mathcal{G},\mathcal{B},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{F}) of the task and produces a correctness decision.
sents.zh: 该任务接收生成的 RGB 图像 x 和任务的正式约束条件（𝒢, ℬ, 𝒜, ℱ）(\mathcal{G},\mathcal{B},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{F})，并输出一个正确性判断。

paragraphs.en: VVR first extracts candidate objects from the generated image using deterministic pixel-level operations. 1) It produces a binary mask for each supported color, with fixed hue and contrast thresholds. 2) Connected-component analysis assigns the same label to foreground pixels connected by a path of edge- or corner-adjacent pixels; each labeled region is a candidate object. 3) Fixed contour measurements classify each candidate into one of the supported shapes (circle, square, or triangle) based on its aspect ratio, bounding-box coverage, and convexity. 4) Candidates are then matched to object groups by the color and shape constraints of each group. Appendix C.1 visualizes the extraction pipeline, including the color map and shape classifier, as well as the handling of ambiguous colors, irregular contours, fragmented objects, and blurred boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: VVR 首先通过确定性的像素级操作从生成的图像中提取候选对象。1) 它为每种支持的颜色生成一个二进制掩码，并设置固定的色调和对比度阈值。2) 连通分量分析将沿边缘或角落相邻像素路径相连的前景像素分配相同的标签；每个被标记的区域即为一个候选对象。3) 通过固定的轮廓测量，根据候选对象的宽高比、边界框覆盖率和凸性，将其分类为支持的形状之一（圆形、方形或三角形）。4) 随后，候选对象将根据各对象组的颜色和形状约束与这些对象组进行匹配。 附录 C.1 展示了提取流程的可视化过程，包括颜色映射和形状分类器，以及如何处理模糊的颜色、不规则的轮廓、碎片化的对象和模糊的边界。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on three benchmark splits (Table 2 ). 1) VVRBench , the main benchmark, contains 10,000 tasks of complexity 3 to 48, which we report in five ranges C 1 C_{1} to C 5 C_{5} of about 2,000 tasks each. 2) VVRBench -Fast is an 820-task subset covering the same range with 20 tasks at each integer complexity for evaluating image APIs at a twelfth of the generation cost. 3) VVRBench -Challenge contains 720 tasks of complexity 45 to 80 and adds 14 more difficult, group level constraint types, above the VVRBench range, to separate the strongest generators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个基准测试分集中进行了评估（表 2）。1) VVRBench 是主要基准测试，包含 10,000 个复杂度为 3 到 48 的任务，我们将其分为五个范围 C₁ 到 C₅，每个范围约含 2,000 个任务。2) VVRBench-Fast 是一个包含 820 个任务的子集，覆盖了相同的复杂度范围，并在每个整数复杂度上设置 20 个任务，用于以生成成本十二分之一的代价评估图像 API。3) VVRBench-Challenge 包含 720 个复杂度为 45 到 80 的任务，并额外增加了 14 种比 VVRBench 范围更难、属于组级约束的类型，以区分出最强的生成模型。

paragraphs.en: With tasks in the complexity range of 3–44, VVRBench -Fast barely separates the strongest frontier models, GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst and GPT-Image-2, with a 2.3-points margin. Therefore, we create VVRBench -Challenge by sampling tasks from the uniform complexity distribution of 45–80 over a wider range of constraints using the VVR generator (Appendix B.5 ). As shown in Table 2 , VVRBench -Challenge discriminates among frontier models and exposes new failure modes. GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst solves 21.39% of Challenge tasks, twice the 10.28% of GPT-Image-2, and its accuracy falls from 31.67% at complexity 45–56 to 24.58% at 57–68 and 7.92% at 69–80. Every other model solves at most 8% of VVRBench -Challenge, suggesting that there is still large room for improvement. Interestingly, we observe occasional abstention behaviors from all Gemini models, stating the instruction is unsatisfiable, demonstrating failure in spatial reasoning (Appendix D.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在复杂度为 3–44 的任务中，VVRBench -Fast 几乎无法区分最强的前沿模型 GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst 和 GPT-Image-2，两者仅相差 2.3 分。 因此，我们使用 VVR 生成器（附录 B.5），从更广泛的约束条件下，通过均匀分布的复杂度范围 45–80 中采样任务，创建了 VVRBench -Challenge。 如表 2 所示，VVRBench -Challenge 能够区分各前沿模型，并揭示了新的失败模式。 GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst 解决了 Challenge 任务的 21.39%，是 GPT-Image-2 的 10.28% 的两倍；其准确率从复杂度 45–56 时的 31.67% 下降至 57–68 时的 24.58%，以及 69–80 时的 7.92%。 其他所有模型解决 VVRBench -Challenge 任务的比例最多不超过 8%，这表明仍有较大的改进空间。 有趣的是，我们观察到所有 Gemini 模型偶尔会出现拒绝回答的行为，声称指令无法被满足，这显示出其在空间推理方面的失败（附录 D.3）。

paragraphs.en: The binary pass-fail score (Eq. 2 ) is composed of individual verifier decisions from each of the active constraints in each task. Figure 3 presents the constraint-level pass rate of the API models on VVRBench -Challenge. paragraphs.en: VVR scores images with program verifiers, avoiding error propagation from unreliable learned evaluators, and is not limited to fixed prompt sets, so training can be scaled to any desired data size and difficulty distributions. These properties allow us to improve image generation instruction following by using VVR as a reward in reinforcement learning (RLVVR). In this section, we post-train image generators with RLVVR to answer the following research questions:
paragraphs.zh: VVR 使用程序验证器对图像进行评分，从而避免不可靠的已学习评估器导致的错误传播，并且不受固定提示集的限制，因此训练可以扩展至任意所需的数据规模和难度分布。 这些特性使我们能够将 VVR 用作强化学习中的奖励（RLVVR），从而改进图像生成指令的执行能力。 在本节中，我们将使用 RLVVR 对图像生成器进行后训练，以回答以下研究问题：

sents.en: VVR scores images with program verifiers, avoiding error propagation from unreliable learned evaluators, and is not limited to fixed prompt sets, so training can be scaled to any desired data size and difficulty distributions.

sents.en: These properties allow us to improve image generation instruction following by using VVR as a reward in reinforcement learning (RLVVR).

sents.en: In this section, we post-train image generators with RLVVR to answer the following research questions:

paragraphs.en: Does RLVVR teach precise instruction following, and how does the complexity of the training tasks shape what is learned?

paragraphs.en: We generate two training corpora using the VVR generator (§ 2.2 ). VVR-Easy contains tasks that contain at most one constraint family and have complexity of at most 20, and VVR-Matched matches the VVRBench distribution (complexity 3–48). Each dataset contains 100K VVR tasks after decontamination from benchmark data (Table 2 ). For reward-mixture experiments, we train with GenEval2 ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) , OCR ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , and a five-reward objective that combines GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) , GenEval2, OCR, PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) , and UnifiedReward ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Each of these objectives is trained alone and mixed with VVR-Easy, with equal number of prompts per objective.

paragraphs.en: VVR-Easy also scores higher on 6 out of 9 natural prompt benchmarks than the model trained with the GenEval2 reward, whose training prompts name real objects—especially GenEval (0.729 vs. 0.688) and OCR (0.587 vs. 0.501). Notably, the GenEval gain comes from position ( + 0.150 +0.150 ), counting ( + 0.103 +0.103 ), and color attribution ( + 0.025 +0.025 ), all skills that VVR trains, while the single object, two object, and colors categories are comparable to the GenEval2-trained model.

paragraphs.en: Verifiable rewards. Verifiable rewards score language-model outputs with executable rules, such as exact-answer checks ( Guo et al., 2025 ) and instruction-constraint checks ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Lambert et al., 2025 ) , and procedural environments generate such tasks at controlled difficulty ( Stojanovski et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . Johnson et al. (2017) derive visual questions and their answers from generated scenes; VVR derives image-generation prompts and their constraints the same way. For generated SVG and TikZ programs, rewards check the geometry of the rendered program ( Li et al., 2026 ) or compare its rendering with a reference image ( Rodriguez et al., 2025 ; Belouadi et al., 2024 ) ; VVR instead verifies generated pixels, with no program or reference image, and accepts any image that satisfies the constraints.

Diffusion and flow models are post-trained with policy gradients ( Black et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2023 ) , differentiable rewards ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Clark et al., 2024 ) , preference optimization ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) , and online reinforcement learning for flow models ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Xue et al., 2025 ) . Liu et al. (2025a) score GenEval detections ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) and OCR outputs, Zhou et al. (2026) combine detectors with a vision-language model, and Huang et al. (2026) answer decomposed questions with a multimodal model. Errors in these learned signals can be exploited during optimization ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . The compressibility reward of Black et al. (2024) needs no learned model but does not depend on the prompt. RLVVR computes a prompt-specific reward from the generated pixels without a learned model, and it can be mixed with these objectives.

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image evaluation. Text-to-image evaluation uses embedding and question-answering metrics ( Hessel et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2023 ; Cho et al., 2024a ; Lin et al., 2024 ) and prompt-alignment and compositional benchmarks ( Saharia et al., 2022 ; Yu et al., 2022 ; Ghosh et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) , all of which score images with learned models. Kamath et al. (2025) replace the GenEval detector with a vision-language judge because detector scores diverged from human judgments on stronger generators. Wu et al. (2024) and Cho et al. (2024b) use synthetic visual concepts in their prompts but score the outputs with a detector or a VLM. VVRBench scores every constraint exactly, with the same program verifiers that provide the RLVVR reward.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR), where open-ended image generation can be scored by deterministic program verifiers to provide both evaluation feedback and post-training signals. VVR tasks can be generated procedurally given any target distribution over constraint types and complexity levels. We release VVRBench , 10K verifiable image generation tasks where the model is asked to draw geometric objects with specified color, shape, count, and spatial relations, and show that models struggle with visual instruction following. A VVRBench -Challenge set where the strongest frontier image generation model, GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst, solves only 21.4% of the tasks. We then train image generators with VVR scores as an RL reward (RLVVR) significantly improves instruction following both on VVR tasks and on natural prompts unseen during training. Mixing VVR with existing post-training objectives for image generation, such as GenEval2, leads to further gains on a broad evaluation suite and human preference, motivating its adoption into standard post-training recipes.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了可验证视觉奖励（Verifiable Visual Rewards，VVR），通过确定性程序验证器对开放式图像生成进行评分，从而提供评估反馈和训练后信号。 给定任何关于约束类型和复杂程度的目标分布，VVR任务都可以通过程序化方式生成。 我们发布了VVRBench，其中包含1万个可验证的图像生成任务，要求模型绘制具有指定颜色、形状、数量及空间关系的几何对象，并证明了模型在执行视觉指令方面存在困难。 在VVRBench挑战集中，当前最强的图像生成模型GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst仅能解决其中21.4%的任务。 随后，我们将VVR分数作为强化学习奖励（RLVVR）来训练图像生成器，显著提升了模型在VVR任务以及训练时未接触过的自然语言提示中的指令执行能力。 将VVR与现有的图像生成训练后目标（如GenEval2）相结合，在广泛的评估套件和人类偏好测试中带来了进一步的提升，这促使我们将VVR纳入标准的训练后流程中。

paragraphs.en: Several API models incorrectly decline some VVR tasks as contradictory, although every task is satisfiable. Our analysis is constrained to case studies due to the small number of abstentions, but VVR tasks can be used to evaluate, and further train for, correct abstention decisions in image generators, VLM, and even LLMs to improve spatial reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 多个 API 模型错误地将某些 VVR 任务判定为相互矛盾，尽管每个任务实际上都是可以满足的。 由于弃权案例数量较少，我们的分析仅限于案例研究；但 VVR 任务可用于评估图像生成器、VLM 甚至 LLM 在正确做出弃权决策方面的表现，并进一步训练这些模型以增强其空间推理能力。

paragraphs.en: The generator changes one constraint while holding the reference image fixed and requires the verifier to reject the image under the changed task. paragraphs.en: The generator crosses each stratum and each composition of two, three, and four to six strata with five scene-size settings, which control the number of object groups and instances. Each single stratum receives 50 candidates per setting, and each composition order receives 600 candidates per setting, divided evenly over stratum combinations, for 11,250 candidates. Selection caps the number of tasks at each integer complexity by removing candidates from the most populated complexities, and adds single-object tasks at complexities the generator does not otherwise reach. VVRBench uses 32 of the 46 constraint types; the remaining 14 appear only in VVRBench -Challenge (Table 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该生成器遍历每个层以及由两层、三层和四层（共四至六层）组成的每种组合，并采用五种场景规模设置，这些设置用于控制对象组与实例的数量。 每个单独层在每种设置下获得 50 个候选项，而每种组合顺序在每种设置下获得 600 个候选项，这些候选项均匀分配给各层组合，总计 11,250 个候选项。 选择机制通过从复杂度最高的情况中移除候选项，将每个整数复杂度下的任务数量限制在一定范围内，并在生成器原本无法达到的复杂度下添加单对象任务。 VVRBench 使用了 46 种约束类型中的 32 种；其余 14 种仅出现在 VVRBench -Challenge 中（表 7）。

paragraphs.en: The first constraint of each candidate cycles through all 46 constraint types, and its reference image is constructed to satisfy it. The generator then adds at most one constraint of each type, skipping duplicate relations and combinations that cannot hold together, and every prefix of the added constraints is a candidate. Besides the targets in Table 8 , selection allows at most two thirds of a task’s complexity to come from color, shape, and exact count constraints, and balances complexity across families and constraint types within each family.
paragraphs.zh: 每个候选项的第一个约束会遍历全部 46 种约束类型，其参考图像也会根据这些约束进行构建。 随后，生成器会为每种类型最多添加一个约束，跳过重复的关系以及无法同时成立的组合；所添加约束的每个前缀都是一个候选项。 除了表 8 中的目标外，选择机制允许一项任务的复杂度中最多有三分之二来自颜色、形状和精确数量方面的约束，并在每个家族内部以及不同约束类型之间平衡复杂度。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the verifier of § 2.3 : object extraction, the program verifiers, the scores and training reward, and its validation.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了第 2.3 节的验证器：对象提取、程序验证器、得分与训练奖励，以及其验证过程。

paragraphs.en: The verifier estimates the background as the median color along the image boundary and uses variation among those boundary pixels to set a background-relative foreground threshold. It converts the image to HSV and assigns sufficiently saturated foreground pixels to fixed, nonoverlapping hue ranges for the eight supported colors. Low-confidence and background-like pixels are excluded. On each binary color mask, erosion followed by dilation removes isolated foreground pixels, and dilation followed by erosion fills small holes and narrow breaks. The implementation scans the cleaned mask and uses flood fill from each unlabeled foreground pixel, traversing horizontal, vertical, and diagonal neighbors. Every maximal set reached by one traversal becomes a candidate object.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器将背景估计为图像边界沿线的中值颜色，并利用这些边界像素之间的差异来设置一个相对于背景的前景阈值。 它将图像转换为 HSV 格式，并将饱和度足够高的前景像素分配给八个支持颜色的固定、不重叠的色调范围。 置信度低且类似背景的像素会被排除。 在每个二值颜色掩膜上，先进行腐蚀再进行膨胀可以移除孤立的前景像素，而先进行膨胀再进行腐蚀则可以填充小孔和狭窄的断裂处。 该实现会扫描清理后的掩膜，并从每个未标记的前景像素开始使用洪水填充算法，遍历水平、垂直和对角方向的相邻像素。 每次遍历所达到的每一个最大集合都会成为一个候选对象。

paragraphs.en: Each component is described by its area, centroid, bounding box, boundary, aspect ratio, bounding-box occupancy, convexity, convex-hull vertex count, number of holes, and offset between its centroid and bounding-box center. A fixed geometric classifier converts these measurements into circle, square, and triangle scores. Circle scores favor approximately equal width and height, high convexity, and rounded contours; square scores cover both filled axis-aligned boxes and centered, convex rotated squares; triangle scores use their characteristic bounding-box occupancy and off-center centroid. A single hole provides additional evidence for an outlined circle or square. Components that are too small, narrow, or weakly supported by the requested color and shape are removed. If several requested groups have the same color but different shapes, each component is assigned exclusively to the shape receiving its highest score. Figure 8 shows the color masks, components, and shape scores for three API model outputs, and Figure 9 shows the same steps on distorted open-weight generations with ambiguous colors, irregular contours, and blurred boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 每个组件都通过其面积、质心、边界框、边界、纵横比、边界框占用率、凸性、凸包顶点数、孔洞数量，以及质心与边界框中心之间的偏移量来描述。 一个固定的几何分类器将这些测量值转换为圆形、方形和三角形得分。 圆形得分倾向于宽度和高度大致相等、高凸性和圆润的轮廓；方形得分涵盖填充的轴对齐矩形框以及居中的旋转凸正方形；三角形得分则利用其特有的边界框占用率和偏离中心的质心。 单个孔洞为识别轮廓化的圆形或方形提供了额外证据。 尺寸过小、过窄，或由所需颜色和形状提供的支撑较弱的组件会被移除。 如果多个请求组具有相同的颜色但形状不同，则每个组件将仅分配给得分最高的形状。 图 8 展示了三个 API 模型输出的颜色掩码、组件和形状得分，而图 9 则展示了在具有模糊颜色、不规则轮廓和模糊边界的失真开放权重生成数据上执行相同步骤的结果。

paragraphs.en: The frozen rules include three safeguards for imperfect generations. First, background-adaptive contrast and calibrated hue boundaries handle shading and colors near category boundaries. Explicit boundary rules separate pale, low-saturation red from pink and muted blue-violet from bright blue. Second, morphological cleanup and a shape-conditioned fallback mask recover objects with fragmented or blurred color regions without allowing one component to satisfy two color groups. Third, robust extents use the 5th and 95th percentiles of component coordinates, reducing sensitivity to stray boundary pixels. The exact thresholds are fixed in the released verifier. Appendix C.3 reports calibration and held-out tests covering ambiguous colors, irregular contours, compression, blur, touching objects, and threshold-adjacent cases.
paragraphs.zh: 这些固化的规则包含三项针对不完美的生成结果的保障机制。 首先，背景自适应对比度和校准后的色相边界能够处理靠近类别边界的阴影和颜色。 明确的边界规则将浅淡、低饱和度的红色与粉色区分开，也将柔和的蓝紫色与明亮的蓝色区分开。 其次，形态学清理和基于形状的条件备用掩码可以恢复具有碎片化或模糊颜色区域的物体，同时防止单个组件满足两个颜色组的要求。 第三，稳健的范围使用组件坐标的第 5 和第 95 百分位数，从而降低对边缘异常像素的敏感度。 精确的阈值在已发布的验证器中是固定的。 附录 C.3 报告了校准和预留测试的结果，涵盖了模糊颜色、不规则轮廓、压缩、模糊、接触物体以及接近阈值的案例。

paragraphs.en: The verifier passes 290 historical edge cases, 360 direct checks, 14,788 metamorphic checks, a 320-case matrix of single constraints, 200 constructed cases at decision thresholds, and geometry tests for repeated-group size, containment, contact, and relation inverses. These tests cover blur, compression, low contrast, irregular contours, touching and merged components, missing objects, and reversed relations. During development, 3,947 human decisions set the decision boundary of each perceptual predicate: the hue range of every color name, the margin at which two objects touch, the contour tolerances that separate circles, squares, and triangles, and the ratio at which one object counts as larger than another.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器通过了 290 个历史边缘案例、360 项直接检查、14,788 项形态变化检查、一个包含 320 种情况的单约束矩阵、决策阈值处的 200 个构造案例，以及对重复组大小、包含关系、接触关系和关系逆运算的几何测试。 这些测试涵盖了模糊、压缩、低对比度、不规则轮廓、相互接触和合并的组件、缺失对象以及关系反转等情况。 在开发过程中，3,947 项人类决策确定了每个感知谓词的决策边界：每种颜色名称的色相范围、两个物体开始接触的临界边缘、区分圆形、方形和三角形的轮廓容差，以及一个物体被视为比另一个物体更大的比例阈值。

paragraphs.en: Two human audits test the verifier on generated images. Each audit image tests one constraint, labeled by one annotator without seeing the verifier’s decision. The larger audit contains 512 images of 128 prompts generated by pretrained SD3.5-M, FLUX.1-dev, and two SD3.5-M models trained with earlier VVR rewards. The verifier version frozen before this audit agrees with 454 of 508 decisive labels (89.4%, Cohen’s κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 ), and an earlier audit of 528 images agrees on 421 of 452 (93.1%, κ = 0.86 \kappa=0.86 ). After calibration that used the larger audit, the released verifier, which scores every result in this paper, agrees with 481 of its 508 labels (94.7%, κ = 0.89 \kappa=0.89 ).

paragraphs.en: Three annotators each compare the same 400 image pairs and choose the image they prefer given the prompt, with a tie option. The study contains two comparisons, VVR-Easy against the pretrained model and GenEval2 mixed with VVR-Easy against GenEval2, and each of five prompt suites contributes 40 prompts to each comparison. The 400-prompt study uses 80 unique prompts from each of VVR, GenEval2, GenEval, OCR, and DrawBench. The VVR prompts were drawn, 16 from each of five complexity bins, from a candidate pool of 11,250 tasks that preceded the final benchmark; 74 of them are VVRBench tasks, and none appears in VVR-Easy or Challenge. The GenEval sample is balanced across its six task categories. Each prompt appears in one comparison, paired generations share a sampling seed, and model identity and left and right order are hidden during annotation. Each annotator sees the pairs in an independently randomized order and left-right assignment. Win rates average each prompt’s score over the annotators (win 1, tie 0.5, loss 0), and intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals over prompts. Each annotator separately favors the VVR-trained model in every suite of both comparisons. On pairs where both annotators chose an image, the mean pairwise agreement is 83.8% (84.9%, 81.9%, and 84.6% for the three annotator pairs), and Fleiss’ κ \kappa among the three annotators, with ties as a third label, is 0.49. Table 18 gives the agreement of each annotator pair.
